review: I like the bones here. Laser Gate is the best stage: the dotted beams telegraph the cycle, so I can route a no-stop line and every death is mine. Gauntlet mixes crumble tiles, ferry, spring and laser into a real final exam. But the curve is lumpy. First Steps kills 29 of 100 on one flat spike strip, Saw Mill and Ferry Lines drop to about half for mid players, then Spring Loaded is a 93% victory lap with saws far above my arc. Saw Mill saws float with no visible path, so I cannot plan a cycle. Spike Garden is one jump repeated.
best: Laser Gate has readable beam timing that rewards a clean, non-stop route.
worst: Spring Loaded has almost no risk, and it sits right after two stages that are harder than it.
